prompt_text: What is the best tanning salon in Charlotte NC?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” tanning salon in Charlotte — the right place depends on what you want (spray tan vs. UV beds), your neighborhood, budget, and priorities (price, cleanliness, experience level of techs, product types). I can help you find the best option for you — quick questions first:

- Do you want a spray (sunless) tan or UV/tanning beds?
- Which area of Charlotte or what ZIP code is most convenient?
- Any preferences (cruelty-free/organic solutions, boutique vs. chain, low-cost vs. premium)?

If you want general guidance right away, here’s how to pick the best salon and some common, reliable options to consider:

How to choose
- Reviews: look for 4.5+ stars on Google and Yelp with recent (last 6–12 months) reviews and photos.
- Cleanliness & professionalism: ask about how booths are cleaned and if techs are certified for spray tanning.
- Product transparency: for spray tans, ask what DHA solution they use, if it’s fragrance-free/vegan, and whether they do a patch test.
- Equipment: for UV beds, ask the brand (Ergoline, KBL), bulb age, and session lengths for your skin type.
- Pricing & packages: chains often have membership plans; boutique studios may offer single-session specialty looks.
- Before/after photos: request or review client photos for tone and longevity.
- Safety: remember UV tanning increases skin cancer risk — sunless spray tans are much safer.

Common options (chains with multiple Charlotte locations)
- Palm Beach Tan — consistent equipment, membership options, spray and UV services
- Sun Tan City — multiple locations, affordable memberships and bed variety

If you want boutique or top-rated local salons, tell me your neighborhood or ZIP and whether you want spray vs. UV and I’ll give tailored recommendations and what to check in their latest reviews.
